resources.string: Control the installed GlassMic KSU module (0.1.0.9 or a compatible revision). Requires Root and Zygisk. Remove target apps from the old LSPosed scope and restart them to avoid competing recording backends.
Shared with the module WebUI. Import WAV, MP3 or FLAC (up to 512 MiB). The original app library stays separate. Tap a file to play it.
No module audio yet. Import a file to get started.
Saved directly to the KSU module and shared with its WebUI. Fully restart newly selected apps. Removing an app restores its real microphone immediately. The module protects critical system apps.
Disconnected (the module may still be running)
Operation failed: %1$s. Check that the module is installed and enabled, grant this app Root access, then retry.
KSU has not confirmed real microphone mode. Restore the mic in its WebUI, reconnect, then retry switching backends.

Closing this page or the floating controls keeps audio running. Use “Restore mic & disconnect” to end control. If the app exits unexpectedly, file playback may continue; live input ends and restores the real microphone.
Mixing applies to file and live modes. Pausing keeps your voice; Silence mutes everything.
Mixing requires module 0.1.0.10 or newer. Restart target apps after updating.
Capture the selected music app into the module. Playback stays audible on the phone. Keep the APP service running; the source cannot also be a recording target.
Live input requires module 0.1.0.11 or newer. Choose a source app on the main control page.
